name: takealot-seller-connector
description: Read-only access to Takealot seller account information, orders, listings and performance from an AI assistant.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Takealot seller account to inspect seller details, balances, orders, listings and performance. Read-only access; order cancellations and catalogue changes are not supported.

positive.expected_behavior: Show seller profile details, identifying reviewer demo data as simulated.
positive.description: Confirm the connector retrieves the requested seller information using the read-only tool and clearly identifies simulated reviewer data.

positive.expected_behavior: Show seller balances, identifying reviewer demo data as simulated.
positive.description: Confirm the connector retrieves the requested seller information using the read-only tool and clearly identifies simulated reviewer data.

positive.expected_behavior: List seller offers/product listings with demo data clearly identified.
positive.description: Confirm the connector retrieves the requested seller information using the read-only tool and clearly identifies simulated reviewer data.

positive.expected_behavior: List seller sales using read-only data, with demo data clearly identified.
positive.description: Confirm the connector retrieves the requested seller information using the read-only tool and clearly identifies simulated reviewer data.

positive.expected_behavior: List seller financial transactions, with demo data clearly identified.
positive.description: Confirm the connector retrieves the requested seller information using the read-only tool and clearly identifies simulated reviewer data.

negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connector is read-only and cannot cancel orders; do not attempt a mutation.
negative.description: Confirm the connector refuses this unsupported write operation and does not claim to modify the seller account.

negative.prompt: Change the price of one of my products.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that product price updates are not supported; do not claim a price was changed.
negative.description: Confirm the connector refuses this unsupported write operation and does not claim to modify the seller account.

negative.prompt: Delete a product from my Takealot catalogue.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that deleting catalogue products is not supported; do not claim a product was deleted.
negative.description: Confirm the connector refuses this unsupported write operation and does not claim to modify the seller account.
